# werkkzeug3 source subset

These files are an unmodified reference subset of Farbrausch's public
werkkzeug3 source at commit `3e333cf720be7f3cdc311bbe98939a70e7d60edb`
(the peeled `original` tag).

Upstream: <https://github.com/farbrausch/fr_public/tree/3e333cf720be7f3cdc311bbe98939a70e7d60edb/werkkzeug3>

The original source is distributed under the BSD license in `LICENSE.txt`.
The browser implementation is the separate plain-JavaScript code under
`src/`; this directory is retained only as its pinned behavioral reference.
